After import: Test A assignment with rubric table

The cartridge carries folders, titles, descriptions, and assignment points. Everything on this page has to be set in Schoology by hand.

Import the cartridge

  1. In Schoology, open Resources.
  2. Choose Import, then Common Cartridge, and pick the .imscc file.
  3. When it finishes, open the imported folder and use Add to Course.

Test A: Truss analysis
Assignment		Test A20Any dateAny categoryTest A rubric

Rubrics to enter

No file can import a gradable rubric, so type each one in once. In Schoology, open Resources, choose Add Resources, then Add Rubric. A rubric saved in Resources can be added to any course and reused every year. Enter the criteria in the order shown, with the level points left to right. The cartridge also adds each rubric as a table at the end of the assignment description, so students can read it. That table is only text: it does not grade anything.
